title: LLM Generation Request
description: Provider-neutral request built by cmmc-editorial-prompt-builder and sent by llm-content-generator. Field names are OpenAI-compatible so any OpenAI-compatible provider (Groq initially) can be substituted without changing this contract.

not.description: The request body MUST NOT itself carry an Authorization/API-key value; credentials travel out-of-band via the HTTP call's credential store, never as a request-body field.
